name: DevUtils
description: Develop utils: Drush commands to list entity UUIDs and clear unused files, plus a service to import specific module configuration.
project_description: Tool with several utilities to facilitate development. Features: list the UUIDs of entities (node, media, file, term, block_content, menu_link_content, paragraph) with optional bundle filters and labels via the drush devutils:uuid command; delete files that have no recorded usage via drush devutils:clear-files; and a devutils.update_import service that imports specific configuration objects from a module's config/install or config/optional directory, typically from update hooks. Drush and PHP-service oriented; no admin UI, routes, or permissions.
